title: A look into Calgary's past
description: Use the microfiche machine in the Calgary Central Library to view a newspaper that is at least 50 years old.

title: Walk backwards
description: Take turns walking 50 m backwards along the track while the other walks beside you and keeps you on course. Film each other, then play the videos in reverse to see whose walk looks more normal.

title: Film a duck
description: Film a duck on the pond at West Campus Park.

title: Closest to $20.26
description: At Market Mall, race each other to find an item priced as close to $20.26 as you can. Photograph the price tag.

title: Birdwatching
description: Identify and photograph 5 different species of birds at Inglewood Bird Sanctuary

title: The wisdom of the crowd
description: Ask people near the Calgary Tower to guess its height until the average of all the guesses is within 5 m of the real value (191 m).

title: Planespotting
description: Identify and photograph a Boeing 737, an Airbus A320 and a Boeing 787.

title: Lucky eights
description: 8 is a lucky number in Chinese culture. In Chinatown, set an eight-minute timer and try to photograph 8 instances of the number 8.

title: Price hunt at Chinook
description: At Chinook Centre, race each other to find an item priced as close to $20.26 as you can. Photograph the price tag.

title: Walk the +15
description: Get from Centennial Place to CORE Shopping Centre using only the +15 skywalks, never touching the street.

title: Play foosball
description: Play a game of foosball, first to 5 goals, on the tables in the Engineering building.

title: Downtown view
description: Walk up to the roof of the Art Parkade, keep well clear of the cars, and take a picture of Downtown. Identify five Downtown buildings in your photo.

title: City wildlife
description: For 20 minutes, take pictures of as many wildlife animals as you can with 1 point for birds, 3 points for rodents, and 5 points for large mammals.

title: Guess the loop
description: Explore Prince's Island together for 10 minutes without looking anything up. Then each guess how long the full loop of the island takes to walk, walk it, and see who was closer.

title: Hide and seek at Glenmore
description: Start at the Glenmore Dam viewpoint. One of you hides somewhere along the paths you think can be found in 10 minutes, and the other finds them and takes a photo. Swap, and see who judged the time better. Stay on the paths and well back from the water.
